latest.summary: During the quarter, revenue from new well gas reached nearly INR 4,000 crores, generating an incremental realization of about INR 1,900 crores over the administered pricing mechanism. highlights: During the quarter, revenue from new well gas reached nearly INR 4,000 crores, generating an incremental realization of about INR 1,900 crores over the administered pricing mechanism.
The reported standalone gross revenue of INR 46,460 crore, an increase of over 45% over the corresponding quarter of the last year.
Standalone profit after tax stood at INR 17,034 crore, registering a robust growth of over 112% YoY.
This quarter also witnessed the highest-ever standalone quarterly profit before tax of INR 22,848 crore.
New well gas now contribute approximately 38% of revenue from our nomination gas portfolio, demonstrating the steady migration towards a more remunerating gas basket.

While the group's consolidated performance was impacted by HPCL's net loss of INR 12,265 crore, primarily due to under-recoveries on petroleum products following the sharp increase in crude oil prices during the West…
weaknesses: On oil production side, if we look at the oil production on sequential basis, nominated field oil production has increased 1% QoQ, while the ONGC-operated block NELP is indicating a sharp decline of 8%.
You know, general oil and gas sector, the fields have a natural decline rate, and that is about 5-6%.
Over that, we see the increase. 7% is coming over the natural decline rate of 6-7%.
opportunities: These encompass pipeline replacement, reservoir and pressure management, enhanced water injection, production system upgrades, and several field development initiatives being undertaken.
